name: Unfriendly Competition
summary: A Powderfuse Port proprietor asks you to curb the Eastsea crew's raids on cargo and ships. Their nearest members are along the Eastwind Shore.

sections.title: Along the Shore
sections.body: Ships sink and cargo goes missing, cutting into the proprietor's business at Powderfuse Port. The Eastsea crew's buccaneers and musketeers are the ones closest to the port, along the Eastwind Shore to the north. The proprietor wants you to deal with them first; the rest of the crew's operation remains a concern.

faq.answer: A proprietor at Powderfuse Port asks you to deal with the Eastsea crew.
The Eastsea crew are described as destructive and bloodthirsty, and they steal cargo and sink ships.

faq.q: Why does the proprietor want them stopped?
faq.answer: The crew steals cargo and sinks ships, costing the proprietor money.

faq.q: Where are the Eastsea crew closest to the port?
faq.answer: The crew members closest to Powderfuse Port are along the Eastwind Shore to the north.
